reason: I do the billing myself every month and I sit in front of my bigger clients every quarter, so I reckon I already know where the leakage is. A free audit might be worth a look one quiet week, but I'm not signing up to another £99 a month on top of a PSA I already pay for.
objection: Even with you holding my hand on the exports, it's still 45 minutes plus digging out contracts, and then a report telling me things I half know and haven't had the nerve to bill for. Finding the money isn't the hard bit, having the conversation with a client I've known ten years is.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit actually turned up a few grand I'd genuinely missed, with the tickets to prove it, I'd pay the £99 to keep it running. A recommendation from another MSP owner I trust would get me to book the call in the first place.
